orchestrator.instructions: Coordinate the 5 refactoring phases. Use protocol-specialist, session-specialist, error-specialist, frontend-specialist, realtime-specialist agents. Start with #1, ensure each phase has tests before moving to next.

builder.instructions: Implement code changes for REFACTOR phases. Work with clear specifications. Create tests alongside code. Follow Rust/TypeScript conventions in .claude.md.

explorer.instructions: Map code structure for each REFACTOR. Find all files that need changes. Quick lookups for file locations.

pr-reviewer.instructions: Review each REFACTOR PR. Check: backwards compatibility, tests, no regressions. Focus on the 5 identified gaps.

security.instructions: Security audit for each REFACTOR. Check: auth flow, token handling, injection risks, secret management.
